title: Call For Paper
description: Conference seeks papers in all aspects of Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies. Researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners are invited to submit original research contributions related to intelligent energy systems and sustainable computing solutions.

publication.title: Publication & Awards
publication.description: All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process based on quality, originality, technical contribution, and relevance to the conference theme. Accepted and presented papers will be forwarded to Springer Proceedings subject to publisher quality requirements.

guidelines.title: 1. Manuscript Submission
guidelines.description: Authors are required to submit their manuscripts using Microsoft CMT by following the provided submission link.

guidelines.title: 2. Paper Requirements
guidelines.description: Each manuscript submitted should constitute outstanding and solid advancement in the conference scope and allied disciplines. The main content of the submission should be at least 3500 words or 10 pages as per the publisher format. The references should be limited to 50 and abstract should be limited to 250 words maximum.

guidelines.title: A. Title Page
guidelines.description: Title, name, affiliation of each author and corresponding author email should be included in the title page.

guidelines.title: B. Abstract
guidelines.description: A brief, concise abstract is required at the beginning of each manuscript. The abstract should contain the background, rationale, and main conclusions of the work. It should be 250 words or less, unreferenced, and should avoid mathematical expressions, footnotes, citations, and first-person sentence structures.

guidelines.title: D. Text Formatting
guidelines.description: The text (12-point) should be typeset in one column and divided into sections with numbered headings using the following hierarchy: Primary heading, Secondary heading, Tertiary heading, and Quaternary heading.

guidelines.title: E. Acknowledgements
guidelines.description: Keep this section brief by acknowledging only direct assistance in research and writing. Financial support should be acknowledged here instead of as footnotes to the title.

guidelines.title: F. References
guidelines.description: References should be arranged alphabetically without numbering. Citations should follow author-year format such as Harsh (1990) or (Harsh, 1990). For three or more authors, use 'et al.'. Distinguishing letters (a, b, c, etc.) should be used for multiple papers by the same author in the same year.

guidelines.title: G. Formulas
guidelines.description: Brief equations or terms should be written inline wherever possible. Complex equations with subscripts, superscripts, or radical signs should use the MathType equation editor.

guidelines.title: H. Figures
guidelines.description: Vector-based figures (eps., ai., or psd.) should be provided upon acceptance of the paper.

guidelines.title: 3. Submission Format
guidelines.description: The submission of manuscripts should be done in PDF format only.

guidelines.title: 4. Review Process
guidelines.description: All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous review process. Acceptance decisions will be based on quality, originality, technical content, and relevance to the conference theme.

guidelines.title: 5. Plagiarism Policy
guidelines.description: Every paper submitted to SAGAR-26 will undergo plagiarism detection using anti-plagiarism software prior to review. Papers not meeting the plagiarism policy may be desk-rejected without further review.

guidelines.title: 6. Publication Requirement
guidelines.description: Only registered and presented papers will be forwarded to SPRINGER PROCEEDING.

guidelines.title: 7. Author Policy
guidelines.description: SAGAR-26 strictly prohibits authors from altering their details or the sequence of authors once a manuscript has been submitted.

tracks.title: Research Tracks
tracks.description: The conference invites submissions in all areas related to Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies, including but not limited to the following tracks:

list.title: Smart Grid Planning and Operation
list.description: Soft computing techniques for smart grid planning, operation, monitoring, and optimization.

list.title: AI & ML for Energy Forecasting
list.description: Artificial intelligence and machine learning methods for load forecasting and renewable energy prediction.

list.title: Power System Optimization
list.description: Optimization techniques for power system operation, control, scheduling, and efficiency improvement.

list.title: Demand Response and Energy Management
list.description: Intelligent demand-side management and demand response strategies for modern power systems.

list.title: Electric Vehicles and Charging Infrastructure
list.description: Optimization and integration of electric vehicles and charging systems into smart grids.

list.title: Energy Storage and Microgrids
list.description: Advanced energy storage technologies, microgrid control, and sustainable energy management.

list.title: Cybersecurity and Smart Grid Protection
list.description: Protection, stability, reliability, and cybersecurity solutions for smart grid infrastructure.

list.title: Hybrid Optimization Algorithms
list.description: Applications of PSO, GA, DE, ACO, SFOA, and other hybrid optimization techniques.

list.title: Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning
list.description: Applications of deep learning and reinforcement learning in smart grid systems and energy analytics.

list.title: Carbon Neutrality and Sustainable Energy Management
list.description: Research focusing on carbon neutrality strategies, sustainable energy utilization, green technologies, and intelligent energy management systems.

list.title: IoT and Communication Technologies
list.description: IoT-enabled smart grids, communication protocols, sensor networks, and intelligent monitoring systems.

footer.title: Ready to Submit?
footer.description: Join researchers and innovators working towards sustainable energy systems, smart grids, and intelligent renewable energy technologies.
